snippet.title: Air Trix (Arcade) - Sega Hikaru
snippet.description:
First of all thanks to *p1pkin* / *MetalliC* ( https://www.youtube.com/@p1pkin ) for sending me this build for testing purposes and recording video content.  

Air Trix
Demul Emulator 2025
Hitmaker
Sega Hikaru

PT-BR 🇧🇷

O jogo possivelmente faz parte da série de Skate da SEGA, tendo o precursor como *Top Skater* (Sega Model 2) e o sucessor como *Ollie King* (Sega Chihiro). 

Para zerar o jogo e ver a cena de créditos você precisa fazer o Rank SSS, mas não consegui configurar o jogo de forma que me permita a fazer os combos corretamente e o máximo que consegui foi o Rank S.

EN-US 🇺🇸

The game is possibly part of SEGA's skateboarding series, with its prequel being *Top Skater* (Sega Model 2) and its sequel being *Ollie King* (Sega Chihiro).

To complete the game and see the credits scene, you need to achieve an SSS rank, but I couldn't configure the game to allow me to perform the combos correctly, and the highest rank I could achieve was S Rank.

⏹ Description ⏹

Air Trix is an arcade skateboarding game in which the player must perform tricks off ramps, those being Combo Tricks, Spin Tricks and Grind Tricks. There are also Special Tricks with command inputs unique to each character. Performing successful tricks earns the players coins and collecting enough coins earns the player a higher grade (on a scale from G to SSS). The player can choose from 5 characters to play as (as well as 2 special characters), each sponsored by a different skateboard clothing company. There is a practice stage and 2 normal stages, each consisting of 2 courses to complete.
